CostAllocation.title: Cost allocation
CostAllocation.description: How one employee's wage costs are split over cost centres and projects for a period: a fixed split in percentages, or by the approved hours booked. Without one, the cost goes to the cost centre of the employee's department (payroll-cost-allocation).

contractId.title: Contract
contractId.description: The contract this split is for. Leave empty to split all of the employee's pay.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Split by fixed percentages, or by the approved hours the employee booked per cost centre and project in the period.

splits.title: Splits
splits.description: For a fixed split: the cost centres and projects with their percentage. The percentages add up to 100.
splits.x-notes: CostAllocationGuardListener refuses a fixed allocation whose splits do not add up to 100 (to the hundredth).

costCenter.title: Cost centre
costCenter.description: The cost-centre code, as the ledger knows it, for example CC-100.

projectId.title: Project
projectId.description: The project code, when the cost is booked on a project.

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: The share of the wage costs, in percent.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: The first day this split applies.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: The last day this split applies. Leave empty while it lasts. Two splits for one employee may not overlap.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why the costs are split this way, for example the subsidy that pays part of the job.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7).

WageCostAllocation.title: Wage cost allocation
WageCostAllocation.description: One line of a payslip's wage costs on one cost centre and project: the share of the gross and the employer charges. The payroll run writes these after every calculation, and the payroll journal books the wage costs per cost centre from them (payroll-cost-allocation).

payslipId.title: Payslip
payslipId.description: The payslip whose costs this line carries.

payrollRunId.title: Payroll run
payrollRunId.description: The run that calculated the payslip.

costCenter.title: Cost centre
costCenter.description: The cost-centre code the costs are booked on. Empty when nothing resolved: the costs are then unallocated.

projectId.title: Project
projectId.description: The project code, when the costs are booked on a project.

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: The share of the payslip's costs on this line.

gross.title: Gross
gross.description: The share of the gross wage, in euros.

employerCharges.title: Employer charges
employerCharges.description: The share of the employer's social charges, in euros.

totalCost.title: Total cost
totalCost.description: Gross plus employer charges on this line, in euros.

allocationSource.title: Source
allocationSource.description: Where the split came from: the employee's fixed split, the hours booked, the department, several departments split equally, or nothing.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Plain string, not a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7).
